findings.statement: REQ-KRN-033 and REQ-ENF-004 assume Claude Code lets the subagent Write into the OS temp dir; Claude Code asks permission for writes outside its working dirs (denied headless), only the session scratchpad inside the temp dir is pre-allowed.
findings.recommendation: Make the order name the session scratchpad (inside os.tmpdir()) or state the prompt; confirm by probe before APPROVED.

findings.statement: REQ-VER-002 priority skipped>failure>error hides the pytest teardown <error> of a skipped testcase: old count NOT_PROVEN, new PROVEN while pytest exits 1; failure+teardown error also drops errors. ADR-0042 p.2 says the pytest count does not change.
findings.recommendation: Let <skipped> outrank only <failure> (node:test todo) and never mask <error>, or amend ADR p.2; add a pytest scenario.

findings.statement: Rolled up: (a) REQ-ENF-004 does not bar the deny reason for an outside path from naming it; guard_events[].reason is committed, so the user dir leaks (F-4 intent). (b) REQ-ENF-007 wants data.received on every SKILL_RESULT_INVALID incl. /run and /skill, design s.4 puts it only in parseEnvelope; SCN-ENF-033 does not assert it. (c) REQ-KRN-033 'from the project root' vs REQ-ENF-004 shell rule: cd <root> && warrant run submit is denied under a visible review Run. (d) Order does not ask for a per-Run file name in the shared temp dir; parallel sessions overwrite each other (caught only by /run). (e) REQ-VER-002 several XML under {out}: 'documents without testcase/testsuite' - all or any. (f) REQ-ENF-007 whitespace-only stdin (USAGE) vs whitespace-only file (SKILL_RESULT_INVALID) unstated. (g) REQ-KRN-033 restart finding omits CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md, also read at session start. (h) REQ-ENF-004 temp dir inside the project: project deny wins, hint points to a denied dir. (i) Open from round 1: F-7 d (deleted beyond ADR p.5, hint ru vs en), F-7 e INFO (python -W error -m pytest unguarded).
findings.recommendation: Clarify each in the next Draft; (b) assert received in SCN-ENF-033, (d) name the file by Run id.

assumptions.statement: pytest junitxml writes <skipped> and <error> in one testcase when a skipped test fails in teardown.
Claude Code prompts for Write outside the working dirs except the session scratchpad.
